page.notes: The first word of the page is a fragment and is kept as printed ("ficilis"). Several words are doubtful at the scan's resolution: "rapiet" (the letter after "rapi" is unclear), "senem" (printed with a form close to J), and "acquiescere". The word "est" at the lower right is a catchword, not text. The line-end "e" with a small tail below "visum" is the catchword.
